content.text:
That’s the **main guard** from `f65a4c2` (`feat: guard edits on main for GitHub projects`) — not sitting in a worktree.

**What it did**
1. Send on `main` (GitHub project) → daemon `CHANGE_REQUIRED`
2. Chat opens **New change** dialog (“Start a change first”)
3. Hold the prompt → after create → resend and the agent continues

**Where it is now**
- Backend still has `CHANGE_REQUIRED` / “Start a change first…” in `src/changes.rs`
- Chat UI for it was removed with ACP in `780839b` and **never re-added** in the new `ChatPanel`
- Same resume pattern still exists for **content/design** (`@created="resume"` + pending save), not for agent send

So the flow you remember is real and landed once; for chat it’s historical, not in current uncommitted work or a live worktree. I can restore that dialog-then-continue path in today’s chat if you want.
So we have this already ?

**Partly.**

- **Backend:** yes — editing on `main` for GitHub projects can still return `CHANGE_REQUIRED`.
- **Content / design:** yes — “Create change” dialog, then resume the pending save.
- **Agent chat:** **no** — that dialog → hold prompt → resend flow was removed with the old chat UI and isn’t in today’s `ChatPanel`.

So the pattern exists; chat doesn’t use it anymore.
[Image #1] See, this is the issue, also when the new change dialog is created, it asked the agent to make the chagne instead so it's a race condition
That matches the `via-agent` path — I'll confirm where the dialog delegates create to the agent and how that races.

Yes — that’s the bug.

**Branch picker / command palette** open `NewChangeDialog` with `via-agent`. Submit does **not** call `store.create()`; it only queues chat text (`Start a new change called "…"`) and toasts “Asked the agent…”.

So you get a race: create depends on the agent (busy, on `main`, dirty tree, permissions), there’s no `@created` to continue anything reliably, and you can also hit the git-flavored dirty toast if sync/create collides with uncommitted work.

**Content / design** already do it right: create via the API, then resume.

The fix is: drop `via-agent` for those entry points (always `store.create`), keep plain “Save or discard…” copy on dirty guards, and if chat needs a change first, dialog → API create → resend prompt — never “ask the agent to create the change.”

Want me to make that change?
Make the change
I'll make create always go through the API (no agent), plain-language dirty copy, and restore the chat “create change then continue” path.

<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref, watch } from "vue";
import { toast } from "vue-sonner";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import {
  Dialog,
  DialogContent,
  DialogDescription,
  DialogFooter,
  DialogHeader,
  DialogTitle,
} from "@/components/ui/dialog";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { errorMessage } from "@orso/utils";
import type { Change } from "@/core/types";
import { useChangesStore } from "./store";

const open = defineModel<boolean>("open", { default: false });
const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    projectId: string;
    heading?: string;
    description?: string;
  }>(),
  {
    heading: "New change",
    description: "Starts from the latest version of the site. Your assistant's saves go on this change.",
  },
);
const emit = defineEmits<{ created: [change: Change] }>();
const store = useChangesStore();

const title = ref("");

watch(open, (isOpen) => {
  if (isOpen) {
    title.value = "";
  }
});

async function submit() {
  if (!title.value.trim() || store.creating) return;
  try {
    const change = await store.create(props.projectId, title.value);
    open.value = false;
    emit("created", change);
  } catch (e) {
    toast.error(errorMessage(e));
  }
}
</script>

<template>
  <Dialog v-model:open="open">
    <DialogContent>
      <form class="grid gap-4" @submit.prevent="submit">
        <DialogHeader>
          <DialogTitle>{{ heading }}</DialogTitle>
          <DialogDescription>{{ description }}</DialogDescription>
        </DialogHeader>
        <Input
          v-model="title"
          placeholder="New post: Launch week"
          aria-label="Change title"
          autofocus
        />
        <DialogFooter>
          <Button type="button" variant="outline" @click="open = false">Cancel</Button>
          <Button type="submit" :disabled="!title.trim() || store.creating">
            {{ store.creating ? "Creating…" : "Create change" }}
          </Button>
        </DialogFooter>
      </form>
    </DialogContent>
  </Dialog>
</template>
